description: Small, synthetic, non-sensitive RAG evaluation dataset. The corpus/questions are the same content as rag_fixtures.py's EVAL_CORPUS/EVAL_QUESTIONS (kept in sync by hand, not generated) — see that module's and scripts/evaluate.py's docstrings for why a dedicated, version-controlled file exists separately from the inline Python fixture test_recall_at_k.py already uses.

corpus.text: Employees may claim reimbursement for business travel expenses including flights, hotels, and meals when accompanied by itemized receipts.
Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the trip's completion to be eligible for reimbursement.
All employees must enable multi-factor authentication on their corporate accounts within the first week of employment.
Passwords must be at least twelve characters long and rotated every ninety days.
Employees working remotely must maintain a stable internet connection and be reachable during core business hours.
The company provides a one-time stipend of $500 to set up a home office.

cases.question: How do I get reimbursed for a business trip?
What's the deadline for submitting an expense report?
Do I need two-factor authentication on my work account?
How often do I need to change my password?
Does the company help pay for home office equipment?
